title: Exploring Multilingual Concepts of Human Values in Large Language Models: Is Value Alignment Consistent, Transferable and Controllable across Languages?
findings: The paper does not report specific findings for religion. Instead, religion is included as a dimension of the 'fairness' value concept, measured using the StereoSet dataset. The general findings for all value concepts (including fairness) are that LLMs encode these concepts multilingually, but their representation shows cross-lingual inconsistency and unidirectional transfer from high- to low-resource languages, heavily influenced by the language distribution in pre-training data.
